name: unchore-defend
description: Security help for defenders: grade a site's security headers (with fixes and a README badge) and read logs, code or a suspicious message to find what happened and what to fix first. Personal data and secrets are masked before anything is sent.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter key (optional)
openrouter_api_key.description: Only for the defend tool, with your own OpenRouter account. It is sent only to OpenRouter. Leave empty to use an Unchore key, or to use only the site check.

unchore_token.title: Unchore key (optional)
unchore_token.description: Only for the defend tool, without an AI account: unchore.ai → Settings → AI → Unchore credit → New key. It is sent only to unchore.ai.
